# Kiana Kazemi

> Kiana Kazemi is an independent Business Strategy Consultant and Founder's Associate. She helps founders and growing businesses with business strategy, growth and go-to-market (GTM) strategy, fundraising readiness, market entry, strategic risk management and execution planning.
